task.subject: The declared workflows of the githubnext/gh-aw-cao repository and their observed AI Credit consumption
task.intent: Let an operator see, without any view-specific code, which declared workflows consume the most observed AI Credits by declaring one derived query that joins the workflow inventory with observed usage totals.
activationConditions: A repository operator declares one or more workflows in githubnext/gh-aw-cao.
Model invocations for those workflows are observed in the dashboard horizon.
The dashboard declares a derived query that joins the declared workflows with the observed usage totals.
requiredEffects: The derived query must project one row per declared workflow with its observed AI Credit total.
A declared workflow without observed usage must remain in the inventory with a zero total rather than being dropped.
Every view must select the derived source by name instead of declaring joins or computed fields inside the view.
noopConditions: No workflow is declared for the repository in the selected horizon.
The usage source is unavailable, in which case the derived source must report an unavailable state instead of a fabricated total.
The horizon contains no model invocation, in which case every declared workflow reports a zero observed total.
successConditions: The derived query validates against the declared source fields before execution.
The inventory table renders one row per declared workflow with its observed AI Credit total.
Workflow ordering by observed AI Credits is deterministic for the same input rows.
uncertainties: Observed AI Credits measure consumption, not delivered operational value.
A missing usage observation is not evidence that a workflow consumed zero credits outside the horizon.
A zero total may reflect an inactive workflow rather than an efficient one.

operationalValue.statement: Operational value is the share of declared workflow cost-review opportunities whose observed AI Credit consumption is presented with matured usage evidence for the same workflow.
operationalValue.opportunity: One declared workflow in githubnext/gh-aw-cao that is eligible for a cost review in the selected horizon.
operationalValue.opportunityKey: repository + workflow opportunity represented by operational-case
acceptedEvidence: A declared workflow row identifying the repository and workflow path.
Observed usage rows whose organization, repository, and workflow identify the same workflow opportunity.
An operational-value observation whose operational-case identifies the same workflow opportunity and whose accepted-evidence-provenance names the accepted usage evidence.

metric.name: workflow-cost-visibility-attainment
metric.definition: 1 when the workflow opportunity is presented with a matured observed AI Credit total for the same operational case; 0 when the matured evidence shows the total could not be attributed to the workflow by cutoff; null when required usage evidence has not matured.

operationalValue.maturation: An opportunity matures when the operational-value observation reaches maturity-status matured after the evidence-cutoff for the same operational case.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Assign 0 only when mature evidence shows the observed consumption could not be attributed to the declared workflow by cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Use null when the usage evidence is absent, unavailable, or not yet matured for the workflow opportunity; do not substitute 0.
